yourway.label: Personal by design
yourway.title: Travel made personal, your way
yourway.subtitle: Generic itineraries are for everyone. Yours should be for you. Luna learns what you love and builds every trip around it.
yourway.point1Body: From street food tours to mountain hikes, Luna surfaces only what genuinely excites you.
yourway.point2Body: Prefer slow mornings and long lunches? Or pack in every hour? Luna adapts to how you like to travel.
yourway.point3Body: Set your range and Luna works within it, no upsells, no surprises.
yourway.chat1: I want 7 days in Japan. I love food and local markets but hate tourist traps.
yourway.chat2: Perfect. I'll build your Tokyo itinerary around Tsukiji outer market, hidden izakayas in Shimokitazawa, and a day trip to Nikko. No tourist traps, promise.
yourway.chat3: Can you make day 3 more relaxed? Maybe a morning at an onsen?
yourway.chat4: Done. I've swapped day 3 to include a morning at Oedo-Onsen Monogatari and a gentle afternoon at Yanaka, one of Tokyo's most charming old neighbourhoods.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Luna Let's Go is a free AI travel planner that creates personalised, day-by-day trip itineraries in about 90 seconds. You tell Luna your destination, travel dates, group size, budget, and travel style, and the AI builds a complete, detailed plan including activities, accommodation suggestions, getting around, budget estimates, and local tips.
faq.q2: How does the AI travel planner work?
faq.a2: Enter your trip details: destination, travel dates, number of travellers, budget level, and preferred travel styles (beach, adventure, culture, family, romance, etc.). Luna's AI analyses your preferences and generates a complete personalised itinerary with a day-by-day schedule, hotel recommendations, transport tips, a budget breakdown, and practical advice for your destination.
faq.q3: Is Luna Let's Go free to use?
faq.a3: Yes. Luna Let's Go is completely free. You can generate a full personalised travel itinerary at no cost, with no account required to get started.
faq.q4: What types of trips can Luna plan?
faq.a4: Luna can plan virtually any type of trip: beach holidays, city breaks, mountain adventures, cultural tours, family holidays, romantic getaways, solo travel, group trips, wellness retreats, and more. It supports all budget levels from budget-friendly to premium luxury.
faq.q5: Can Luna plan family trips with children?
faq.a5: Absolutely. You can specify the ages of your children, and Luna tailors all activities to be age-appropriate and family-friendly, adjusting the pace, activity types, and accommodation recommendations to suit families travelling with kids.
faq.q6: How long does it take to generate a travel itinerary?
faq.a6: Luna generates a complete, detailed travel itinerary in about 90 seconds. The plan includes a day-by-day schedule, accommodation options, transport advice, budget breakdown, and local tips, all personalised to your trip.
faq.q7: Can I plan a trip with friends or family?
faq.a7: Yes. After generating your itinerary, you can share it with a link. Your travel group can join and edit the same plan in real time. Each person can also chat with Luna individually. It works for up to 10 collaborators.
faq.q8: How is Luna different from ChatGPT or other AI tools?
faq.a8: Luna is purpose-built for travel planning. Unlike general AI tools, Luna generates structured, day-by-day itineraries with realistic pacing, hotel suggestions, budget breakdowns, and transport advice. You can edit activities directly, chat to refine your plan, and invite others to collaborate. It is a complete planning tool, not a chatbot that outputs text.

explorer.description: You live for the thrill of discovery. Guidebooks bore you. You want the street nobody else found, the village nobody else visited, and the story nobody else can tell.
explorer.travelProfile: Independent, curious and adaptable. You plan loosely and leave room for magic. Your best memories are the ones that were not on any itinerary.
explorer.tripStyle: Mix of transport modes, guesthouses with character, flexible itinerary, at least one moment that surprises even you.
askLuna: What hidden spots should I add that most tourists miss?
Can you redesign Day 3 to include a lesser-known area nearby?
Replace the touristy activities in my plan with something local.

foodie.description: Your itinerary is built around meals. You research restaurants before you book flights, wake up for morning markets, and judge a city entirely by its street food.
foodie.travelProfile: Passionate, adventurous palate, willing to queue for the best bite in town. You always ask locals where they actually eat, not where they send tourists.
foodie.tripStyle: Neighbourhood food walks, market mornings, at least one cooking class, curated restaurant list from local chefs, and a wine or spirits trail.
askLuna: Add the best local market to Day 1 of my trip.
Replace the generic restaurant on Day 4 with something the locals actually go to.
What street food should I absolutely not miss here?

relaxer.description: Your holiday is a recovery. You want white sand, warm water, a good book and absolutely nothing urgent on the schedule. If you rush, you are doing it wrong.
relaxer.travelProfile: You recharge by doing less, not more. You choose destinations over checklists and experiences over sightseeing counts.
relaxer.tripStyle: Beachfront stay, lazy mornings, spa days in the plan, minimal transfers, and evenings that end early by choice not necessity.
askLuna: Slow down the pace of Day 2 and remove back-to-back activities.
Add a spa afternoon somewhere in my itinerary.
Which beach in my destination is the quietest and least crowded?

photographer.description: You see the world through a lens. Golden hour is sacred, composition is everything, and you will absolutely get up at 5am for the perfect shot.
photographer.travelProfile: Highly visual, detail-oriented and patient. You share your journey through images that stop the scroll. The best moment is always the one you almost missed.
photographer.tripStyle: Itinerary timed around sunrise and sunset, viewpoints mapped in advance, slow pacing to actually compose shots, minimal back-to-back activities.
askLuna: Add a sunrise activity to Day 1 and tell me the best viewpoint.
Which spots in my itinerary are the most photogenic?
Suggest a photography-focused day tour at my destination.

culture.description: You come home knowing more than when you left. Museums, architecture, history and local traditions are what make a trip genuinely meaningful.
culture.travelProfile: Intellectually driven and respectful of local customs. You want context, not just photos. You ask why before you ask where.
culture.tripStyle: Museum mornings, historic quarter walks, local guide for context, at least one cultural workshop or performance, neighbourhood exploration off the main drag.
askLuna: Add a locally guided history walk to my first full day.
What cultural workshop or class should I book at this destination?
Replace one generic activity with something more historically significant.

adventurer.description: You want to come home with stories that make people say you did what. Physical challenge, outdoor intensity and pushing your limits is the whole point.
adventurer.travelProfile: Physically capable, fearless and motivated by challenge. You book the hike, the jump and the climb before you even look at the hotel.
adventurer.tripStyle: Multi-day trek, water sport or extreme activity, nature-based accommodation, minimal urban time, and at least one thing that scares you a little.
askLuna: Add a multi-day trekking segment to my trip.
What is the best adventure activity available at my destination?
Swap the city hotel for something closer to the mountains or coast.

luxury.description: You travel to be looked after. Five-star service, exceptional food, private transfers and curated experiences are not upgrades. They are your baseline.
luxury.travelProfile: Discerning, quality-driven and unwilling to compromise. You research properties obsessively and notice immediately when service falls short.
luxury.tripStyle: Five-star resort or boutique luxury property, private guided experiences, Michelin-starred meals, business class or private transfer, personalized attention throughout.
askLuna: Upgrade my accommodation suggestions to five-star or boutique luxury options.
Add a private guided experience to Day 2 instead of the group tour.
What is the finest restaurant at this destination that I should book immediately?

family.description: Every decision on your trip is filtered through one question: will the kids love this? You are simultaneously travel agent, entertainer and logistics wizard.
family.travelProfile: Patient, organised, safety-conscious and always thinking two steps ahead. You know which activities work for all ages and which end in tears.
family.tripStyle: Spacious family accommodation, mix of theme parks and cultural activities, no brutal back-to-back transfers, early dinners and a reliable itinerary with buffer time built in.
askLuna: Make sure all activities in my plan are suitable for children.
Add a theme park or interactive kids experience to Day 3.
What family-friendly restaurant options are near my hotel?

romantic.description: Every moment on your trip is about connection. Sunset views, private dinners, long walks and experiences shared with the person you love most.
romantic.travelProfile: Thoughtful and attentive to atmosphere. You care about the setting as much as the activity and always look for the most intimate version of an experience.
romantic.tripStyle: Boutique hotel or private villa, candlelit dinner booked in advance, couples experiences like cooking classes or private tours, sunsets built into every day.
askLuna: Add a sunset dinner or rooftop experience to our trip.
Book a couples cooking class or wine tasting for Day 3.
What is the most romantic neighbourhood to stay in at this destination?

solo.description: Travelling alone is not a compromise. It is the whole point. You make every decision on your own terms and come home knowing yourself a little better each time.
solo.travelProfile: Self-reliant, open-minded, adaptable and genuinely comfortable in your own company. You make friends easily and love the freedom of zero consensus.
solo.tripStyle: Social hostel or guesthouse with personality, flexible daily structure, solo-friendly group tours for socialising, evenings in lively local areas, real budget consciousness.
askLuna: What are the best solo-friendly group tours or activities here?
Add a social hostel or guesthouse option to my stays.
Which neighbourhoods are safest and most fun for solo travellers at this destination?

party.description: Sleep is for the flight home. You travel for the nights, the music, the crowd and the stories that sound completely unbelievable on Monday morning.
party.travelProfile: Social, energetic and spontaneous. You are always the one who finds the best party in any city. You live fully in the moment and make friends everywhere you go.
party.tripStyle: Central hotel or party hostel, late starts and much later finishes, rooftop bars, beach clubs, underground clubs and at least one full all-nighter written into the plan.
askLuna: Add the best beach club or rooftop bar to my itinerary.
What is the nightlife scene like here and what is the best night to go out?
Shift the Day 2 activities to the afternoon so we can recover from the night before.

festival.description: You build your entire year around events. Whether it is Carnival, Tomorrowland or a local street festival, the event is not just part of the trip. It is the destination.
festival.travelProfile: Organised at least around events. Culturally engaged and passionate about shared collective experiences. You have a bucket list of events, not just places.
festival.tripStyle: Dates locked around the event, accommodation near the festival grounds, day-before exploration and day-after recovery built in, a blend of event intensity and local culture.
askLuna: What major festivals or events are happening at my destination around my travel dates?
Add a recovery day after the main event in my itinerary.
What should I do in the city before the festival starts?

beach_bum.description: Your perfect day starts with bare feet on warm sand, peaks at a beach bar with something cold in hand, and ends watching the horizon turn gold. The beach is not just a destination. It is a lifestyle.
beach_bum.travelProfile: Laid-back but sociable. You gravitate toward places where beach culture is the whole identity. You have a sixth sense for finding the best beach bar on any coast and you always know where the vibe is right.
beach_bum.tripStyle: Beachfront accommodation as close to the water as possible, beach club days, cocktail hours at sunset, social evenings that start easy and end when the mood says so, and at least one stretch of sand that makes you stop scrolling.
askLuna: What is the best beach bar at my destination and what time should I arrive?
Find me the most beautiful beach near my hotel that locals actually use.
Add a beach club day to my itinerary with food, cocktails and ocean access.

about.heroSubtitle: Luna Let's Go started with a simple frustration and a shared dream: to make every trip as good as the one you imagined.
about.storyH2: A frustration turned into a mission.
about.wilsonBio: Always the one with twenty tabs open at once, trying to cross-reference blogs, old forum posts and outdated guides just to plan a single week away. There had to be a better way.
about.fatimaBio: The adventurous spirit who would book the flight first and figure out the details later. Still, she would spend weeks hunting for the right excursions and hidden gems worth the detour.
about.storyP1: We are Wilson and Fatima, a couple bound by one shared obsession: travel. We are the kind of people who, the moment one trip ends, are already dreaming about the next one. We have jumped on flights at short notice, navigated countries without speaking a word of the language, and chased sunrises in places we could barely point to on a map. From the chaos of Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo to foam parties in Cancún, from the neon glow of Las Vegas to the magic of Super Nintendo World in Japan. Every trip has given us something we never could have planned for. And that is exactly the point.
about.storyP2Pre: But the planning? That part never felt as exciting as the trip itself. We found ourselves spending hours, sometimes days, sifting through generic blog posts, tourist trap recommendations and conflicting reviews, trying to piece together an itinerary that actually matched who we are and what we genuinely wanted to do. We did not want the highlights reel that everyone gets. We wanted
about.storyQuote: We did not want a generic itinerary. We wanted a plan shaped around us, our pace, our interests, the things that make travel feel alive.
about.storyP3: That is exactly what Luna Let's Go was born to solve. We built a platform that truly listens to you, your travel style, your group, your budget, your passions, and builds a genuinely personalised trip in seconds. Not a template. Not a copy and paste. A plan made for you.
about.storyP4: Yes, the plans are AI-generated, and we are proud of it. But everything we built around that intelligence, the personalisation engine, the refinement tools, Luna the travel assistant, was crafted with real intention and care. We are always improving it, always listening, always asking how we can make this feel even more like yours. Our goal has never changed. We want to give every traveller the chance to have the trip of their life.

intro.heading: Meet Luna
intro.body: Luna is the AI travel assistant inside Luna Let's Go. She helps you build personalised trip itineraries, discover amazing places, and fine-tune every part of your plan through simple conversation.
intro.cardHeading: What Luna can do for you
intro.cardBody: Think of Luna as your personal travel planner. She builds your itinerary based on your preferences, helps you explore options, and adjusts the plan whenever you want. Here is what that looks like in practice:
intro.bullet1: Create a full day-by-day itinerary tailored to your travel style
intro.bullet2: Add, remove, or swap activities at any point
intro.bullet3: Suggest restaurants, attractions, and hidden gems
intro.bullet4: Adjust the pace and structure of your days
intro.bullet5: Answer questions about destinations, activities, and logistics
intro.bullet6: Help you plan collaboratively with travel companions
intro.tipBody: Luna works best when you treat her like a conversation partner. There is no wrong way to ask. Just tell her what you want, and she will take it from there.

featureCards.heading: What You Can Do with Luna
featureCards.subheading: Here is a breakdown of everything Luna can help you with, along with examples of how to ask.

planTrip.heading: Plan your trip
planTrip.body: Start by telling Luna your destination, dates, and travel style. She will generate a complete itinerary organised by day, with activities slotted into morning, afternoon, evening, and night.
planTrip.tipTitle: The more you share, the more personal your trip
planTrip.tipBody: Luna builds your itinerary based on what you tell her. A simple '5 days in Tokyo' will give you a solid starting plan. But tell her who you are travelling with, what you enjoy, how you like to travel, and she will craft something that genuinely feels like yours. Mention your budget, your favourite cuisines, whether you prefer walking or taxis, if you need kid-friendly options, or if you want early mornings or late nights. Every detail helps Luna shape a trip that matches the way you actually like to travel.
planTrip.bullet1: Choose your pace: relaxed, standard, or adventure
planTrip.bullet2: Set preferences like family-friendly, romantic, budget, or luxury
planTrip.bullet3: Include specific interests such as food, culture, nature, or nightlife
planTrip.bullet4: Mention who you are travelling with: solo, couple, family, friends
planTrip.bullet5: Share dietary preferences, mobility needs, or anything that matters to you
planTrip.example1: Plan a 5-day trip to Tokyo for a couple
planTrip.example2: I want a relaxed beach holiday in Bali
planTrip.example3: Family trip to Portugal with two kids under 10
planTrip.example4: Romantic getaway, we love food and hiking

editItinerary.heading: Edit your itinerary
editItinerary.body: Your plan is never locked in. Ask Luna to change anything at any time. She can add new activities, remove ones you do not want, or swap something for a better fit.
editItinerary.bullet1: Add something new to a specific day and time slot
editItinerary.bullet2: Remove an activity you are not interested in
editItinerary.bullet3: Swap one activity for another that suits you better
editItinerary.bullet4: Replace a whole section with a different vibe
editItinerary.example1: Add a beach club to Day 3 afternoon
editItinerary.example3: Replace this with something more relaxed
editItinerary.example4: Swap the morning hike for a spa visit

dayStructure.heading: Modify your day structure
dayStructure.body: Want a slower morning? A free evening? Luna can reshape how your day flows. She adjusts the pace and structure so it matches the kind of day you actually want to have.
dayStructure.bullet1: Make a busy day more relaxed, or a quiet day more active
dayStructure.bullet2: Free up a specific time slot for rest or your own plans
dayStructure.bullet3: Ask Luna to rearrange activities within a day for a better flow
dayStructure.example2: Keep the evening free on Day 4
dayStructure.example3: I want a slow morning and an active afternoon

phases.heading: Organise trip phases
phases.body: For longer trips, your itinerary is grouped into phases. For example, a 14-day Japan trip might have phases like “Tokyo,” “Kyoto,” and “Osaka.” You can rename, split, merge, or reorder these phases to match how you want your trip to flow. You can do this directly in the itinerary or by asking Luna.
phases.bullet1: Rename a phase to reflect your own plan
phases.bullet2: Split a long phase into two shorter ones
phases.bullet3: Merge phases that feel better combined
phases.bullet4: Reorder phases to change the flow of your trip
phases.example1: Rename the first phase to Arrival and Exploring
phases.example2: Split the Kyoto phase into Temples and Nature
phases.example3: Move the Osaka phase before Kyoto
phases.tipBody: You can also edit phase names and reorder them directly in the itinerary interface without chatting with Luna. Both ways work.

explore.heading: Explore more options
explore.body: Not sure what to do next? Ask Luna for alternatives or new ideas. She can suggest places nearby, hidden gems, or completely different options for a specific time slot.
explore.bullet1: Ask for alternatives to any activity in your plan
explore.bullet2: Discover off-the-beaten-path spots and local favourites
explore.bullet3: Get ideas based on your interests: art, nature, food, adventure
explore.example1: What else can I do near Shibuya?
explore.example2: Give me alternatives for this afternoon
explore.example3: Any hidden gems near my hotel?

learnMore.heading: Learn more about activities
learnMore.body: Curious about a place in your itinerary? Ask Luna to tell you more. She can explain what a place is, why it is recommended, what to expect, and whether it is worth your time.
learnMore.example1: Tell me more about TeamLab Planets
learnMore.example3: What should I expect at Senso-ji?
learnMore.example4: How long should I spend here?

food.heading: Food and restaurant suggestions
food.body: Luna can recommend restaurants, cafes, and street food spots tailored to your taste. Whether you want a romantic dinner, a budget-friendly lunch, or the best local cuisine, just ask.
food.bullet1: Specific cuisines: local, Japanese, Italian, seafood, vegan
food.bullet2: Occasions: romantic dinner, family-friendly, casual lunch
food.bullet3: Budget: affordable eats, mid-range, fine dining
food.example1: Suggest a romantic dinner spot for Day 3
food.example2: Where can I find great ramen nearby?
food.example3: Add a budget-friendly lunch to Day 2

generalHelp.heading: General travel help
generalHelp.body: Luna is not just a planner. She is a travel companion you can ask anything. Questions about destinations, logistics, cultural tips, or weather are all fair game.
generalHelp.example1: What is the best time to visit Kyoto?
generalHelp.example2: Do I need a visa for Japan?
generalHelp.example3: What should I pack for Bali in August?
generalHelp.example4: How do I get from the airport to the city?

communication.heading: How to Talk to Luna
communication.body: There are no special commands or syntax. Just talk to Luna the way you would talk to a friend who happens to be an excellent travel planner.
communication.step1Body: Write in your own words. Full sentences, casual phrases, or quick requests all work.
communication.step2Body: The more detail you give, the better Luna can match your expectations.
communication.step3Body: Luna remembers the conversation. Build on what she suggests with follow-ups.
communication.you1: Can you make Day 4 more chill? I will be tired from hiking.
communication.luna1: Got it! I have swapped the packed Shibuya itinerary for a slower cafe-and-garden day. Take a look.
communication.you2: Perfect, but add a nice dinner spot for that evening.
communication.luna2: Done! I have added a highly-rated yakitori restaurant in the area.

tips.heading: Tips for Best Results
tips.body: Here are a few things to keep in mind to get the most out of Luna.
tips.tip1: Start broad, then refine. Let Luna generate a full plan first. Then go through it day by day and ask for adjustments. This iterative approach produces the best results.
tips.tip2: Tell Luna your preferences early. Travel style, pace, dietary needs, interests, and who you are travelling with all help Luna tailor the plan from the start.
tips.tip3: Do not hesitate to ask for changes. There is no limit to how many times you can modify your itinerary. Luna is built for exactly this kind of back-and-forth.
tips.tip4: Be specific when it matters. Saying "Add something fun" is fine, but "Add a rooftop bar with a view near Shibuya" gives Luna much more to work with.
tips.tip5: Use Luna throughout your planning. She is not a one-time generator. Come back to refine, ask questions, or explore alternatives whenever inspiration strikes.
tips.tip6: Tell Luna which day. When adding or changing an activity, mention the specific day. This helps Luna place it in exactly the right spot.

footerCta.body: Ready to plan your next adventure? Open your trip and start chatting with Luna.
